checks.name: single_connected_hierarchy
checks.threshold: one grounded root; unique roles; every role reachable; no cycle

checks.name: finite_nonzero_segments
checks.threshold: finite XYZ and all parent segments >.001cm

checks.name: root_grounded_distinct_pelvis
checks.threshold: root=(0,0,0), pelvis >50cm away

checks.name: left_right_not_crossed
checks.threshold: positive left, negative right; clavicle roots relative to thoracic parent X, all limb articulations relative to grounded canonical origin

checks.name: bilateral_body_consistency
checks.threshold: maximum mirrored role difference <6cm; prototype tolerance

checks.name: ball_forward_l
